name: Harvey Norman Holdings Limited
summary: Harvey Norman Holdings Limited engages in the integrated retail, franchise, property, and digital system businesses. The company engages in the retail of furniture, bedding, computers, and communications and consumer electrical products. It also owns, develops, and manages retail complexes, as well as acts as a lessor of premises to Harvey Norman, Domayne, and Joyce Mayne franchisees, and other third parties. In addition, the company is also involved in the property investment and media placement activities; and provision of other commercial loans and advances. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Homebush West, Australia.
